David Okafor is free from 10:00 to 10:30 on Thursday.

Since Elena is busy, the time proposed by Alison (Thursday at 10:00 AM) will not work.

I will now inform Alison about this in the shared workspace. I will also re-iterate the times that *do* work for Elena and David, so she has them handy.I've checked the calendars and unfortunately, that time won't work. Elena has a conflict at 10:00 AM on Thursday. David is free at that time.

As a reminder, here are the times that work for both Elena and David:
Mon: 11:00, 11:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30
Wed: 13:00, 13:30
Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri: 15:00, 15:30

Let me know if you can find a match.
